# Onboarding where declining is a first-class path

| From | Event | To |
|---|---|---|
| welcome | continue | personalization offer |
| personalization offer | accept | personalizing |
| personalization offer | not now | home (personalization declined) |
| personalizing | done | home |
| personalizing | stop | home (personalization declined) |
| home | open settings | settings |
| home (personalization declined) | open settings | settings |
| settings | close | home |
| home | close app | closed (terminal) |
| home (personalization declined) | close app | closed (terminal) |
